intents.name: verify_email_address
intents.description: I need to know if a specific email address actually exists and can receive messages, so I can clean my contact list, avoid bounces, and ensure my campaigns reach real inboxes.

intents.name: list_car_makes
intents.description: I want to see a complete list of all car manufacturers available in the system, so I can explore options for a new vehicle.

intents.name: fetch_animal_fact
intents.description: I'm looking for an interesting scientific fact about an animal I have in mind—like a fox or a blue whale—so I can share it with friends or use it for a school project.

intents.name: geo_explore_search
intents.description: I'm traveling around a GPS coordinate and want to discover nearby cities, counties or islands. I may limit the search to certain countries or time zones, filter by population size, look for names that start with a prefix, and I want the results sorted (e.g., biggest to smallest).

intents.name: localized_display_query
intents.description: I need the nearby divisions presented in a specific language and optionally in plain ASCII characters, maybe for a multilingual app or a research report. I might also want to include recently deleted places for historical completeness.

intents.name: paged_api_control
intents.description: I'm building an integration that pages through the results. I want to set how many items I get per page, jump to a specific offset, and receive HATEOAS navigation links.

intents.name: nearby_restroom_search
intents.description: I'm out walking in the city and want to see the closest public restrooms to my phone's GPS coordinates. I'd like the results in pages so I can scroll through them.

intents.name: state_restroom_listing
intents.description: I'm planning a road trip across a few US states and need a list of public bathrooms in those states, with the ability to page through the results.

intents.name: search_dog_breeds
intents.description: I'm looking for information about a specific dog breed, but I only know part of its name—like typing 'alaskan' to see both Alaskan Husky and Alaskan Malamute. I want a quick list of matching breeds with basic details.

intents.name: find_exercises_by_name
intents.description: I want to discover workout exercises that match a keyword I type (e.g., 'arm' or 'push'), see their full details, and optionally control how many results I get, move through pages, or order them by difficulty, equipment, or muscle group.

intents.name: fetch_media_news
intents.description: I want to see the latest entertainment headlines – whether it's the general trending news or specific stories about movies, TV shows, or celebrities. I may also want the results tailored to a particular country and language (e.g., French news for France) and I’d like to control how many items I get per page and navigate through pages.

intents.name: search_manga_by_title_with_filters
intents.description: I want to find manga that match a keyword or phrase—like looking for 'One Piece'—and I might also want to limit the results to only safe‑for‑work titles or to manga from a specific region such as Japan, China, or Korea.

intents.name: fetch_stock_quote
intents.description: A user wants to see the latest market price for a specific stock ticker, such as asking for Tesla's current quote or checking the price of any other publicly traded symbol.

intents.name: convert_currency
intents.description: A user wants to know the equivalent amount when converting money from one currency to another, such as checking how many Japanese Yen they would receive for US Dollars.

intents.name: basic_mortgage_estimate
intents.description: I want to quickly see what my monthly mortgage payment would be for a loan I’m considering, given the interest rate, loan amount, and how many years I’ll pay it back.

intents.name: comprehensive_home_cost
intents.description: I’m buying a house and need a full picture of my monthly housing cost, including the loan payment, property taxes, homeowner’s insurance, HOA fees, and I also want to factor in my down‑payment and the home’s total price.

intents.name: search_recipe_by_name
intents.description: A home cook wants to find a recipe by typing a dish name or ingredient phrase, like 'chocolate chip cookies' or 'spicy thai noodle soup', and expects a list of matching recipes to choose from.

intents.name: find_cocktail_by_name_or_ingredients
intents.description: A user wants to discover cocktail recipes they can make or learn about, either by typing part of the cocktail's name (e.g., 'bloody') or by listing the ingredients they have on hand (e.g., 'vodka, lemon juice'), and expects the system to return matching drinks.

intents.name: list_all_mvc2_characters
intents.description: I want to see every character from Marvel vs. Capcom 2 so I can check their abilities, teams, and choose who to play with.

intents.name: find_game_giveaways
intents.description: I'm looking for free game giveaways that match the platforms I use (like Steam, Epic Games Store, or Android). I may also want to narrow it down to just games or loot items, so I can see only the most relevant offers.

intents.name: fetch_champion_stats
intents.description: A player wants to quickly look up the base health, mana, attack damage and scaling stats for a specific League of Legends champion, such as asking "What are Ekko's stats?" or "Show me Jhin's abilities numbers."

intents.name: salary_estimation_lookup
intents.description: I'm looking for the expected salary for a specific job title in a particular location. I may want to narrow the estimate by my experience level (e.g., junior, senior) and choose which salary figures (median, min, max) I see in the response.

intents.name: lookup_timezone_for_location
intents.description: I want to know the time zone details (UTC offset and daylight‑saving info) for a specific place on Earth. I can give you the latitude and longitude, and if I need the offsets for a particular moment in the past or future, I’ll also provide a UNIX timestamp; otherwise you’ll use the current time.

intents.name: planet_lookup_by_name
intents.description: I want detailed information about a single planet I’ve heard of, like "Kepler-186f" or "Proxima Centauri b", and see its known properties.

intents.name: planet_filter_exploration
intents.description: I’m an astronomer looking for planets that fit a set of physical criteria—mass, radius, orbital period, temperature, and distance from Earth—to shortlist candidates for further research.

intents.name: basic_celestial_position_lookup
intents.description: I just want to know when the Sun or Moon will be visible from my home today or tomorrow. I’ll rely on the system’s default latitude, longitude and elevation, and I don’t care about a specific time of day – just the overall rise, set, or highest‑point window for the dates I ask about.

intents.name: custom_observer_position_calculation
intents.description: I’m planning a field observation from a remote mountain camp and need precise azimuth and altitude data for Mars on a specific night. I’ll provide my exact latitude, longitude, elevation, and the exact observation time (or a time range) so the calculation matches my site conditions.

intents.name: basic_arxiv_lookup
intents.description: I'm a student looking for a quick overview of recent papers on a topic. I just type the topic name and, if needed, ask for a few top results so I can skim the abstracts.

intents.name: filtered_arxiv_search
intents.description: I'm a researcher narrowing down literature. I need to search a term but only within a specific date window, maybe only in titles or author fields, and I want to page through many results.

intents.name: list_all_soccer_tournaments
intents.description: A soccer enthusiast asks to see a complete list of current and upcoming soccer tournaments around the world, just to explore what competitions they might want to follow or attend.

intents.name: fetch_latest_f1_news
intents.description: I want to see the most recent Formula 1 news articles from all sources so I can stay up‑to‑date on race results, driver updates, and team announcements.

intents.name: fetch_daily_handball_matches
intents.description: I want to see the list of handball matches scheduled for a specific day so I can decide which games to follow or attend.

intents.name: search_airline_by_identifier_or_name
intents.description: A traveler or aviation enthusiast wants to look up an airline's details. They might know the airline's ICAO three‑letter code, its IATA two‑letter code, or just a part of its name (e.g., typing 'United' to find United Airlines). The system should return matching airline information based on whichever identifier the user provides.

intents.name: search_motorcycle_specs
intents.description: A motorcycle enthusiast wants detailed technical specifications for a bike they're interested in. They may mention the brand (e.g., Harley), a model name fragment (e.g., Ninja), and/or a specific production year (e.g., 2022) to narrow down the results.

intents.name: get_airport_delay_stats
intents.description: I'm planning a trip and need to know how busy the airport I'm using is right now. I want real‑time departure and arrival delay numbers for a specific airport, identified by its IATA or ICAO code, so I can decide if I should leave earlier or consider a different flight.

intents.name: aq_by_coordinates
intents.description: I'm out on a bike ride and my phone's GPS shows my exact latitude and longitude. I want to instantly know the Air Quality Index and pollutant levels right where I am, so I can decide whether to keep going or take a break.

intents.name: aq_by_place_name
intents.description: I'm planning a trip to a city (or a specific state in the US) and need to check the air quality before I book my hotel. I can give the city name, and optionally the state or country, and I want the latest AQI and pollutant details for that location.

intents.name: weather_forecast_by_location
intents.description: A user wants to know the upcoming weather for a particular place—by city name, coordinates, zip code, airport code, or their current IP—so they can plan activities, and they may optionally ask for a specific number of days beyond the default three.
